structured.test_code:
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from llm_router import VideoSchema, describe_media

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")

_VIDEO_PATH = "media/rooftop-jump.mp4"
_START_OFFSET_SECONDS = 5
_END_OFFSET_SECONDS = 45


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_VIDEO_INPUT[revision==2]")
def test_local_video_descriptor_keeps_declared_start_offset() -> None:
    schema = VideoSchema(
        path=_VIDEO_PATH,
        fps=2,
        start_offset=_START_OFFSET_SECONDS,
        end_offset=_END_OFFSET_SECONDS,
    )

    descriptor = describe_media(schema)

    assert descriptor.kind == "video_file"
    assert descriptor.path == _VIDEO_PATH
    assert descriptor.start_offset == _START_OFFSET_SECONDS
    assert descriptor.end_offset == _END_OFFSET_SECONDS
